answer: ZEPHYR-VAULT grove-vouching: a newcomer earns only after an established identity vouches for it, locking a vault slice that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a duplicate of another vouched identity. Vouching chains cap at depth 2, each vouching identity's total collateral at 5x its own stake, and every vouching expires like a zephyr after 3 epochs - the newcomer must then stand on its own passing answers. Attacker cost: N clones need N distinct vouching identities, so a farm either burns N separate vault slices or pays real established identities whose standing is at risk.
